tools.name: go_to_page
tools.label: Go to a page
tools.description: Visibly navigate the portal to a page (Orbit taps the sidebar item). Returns which surfaces are now on screen.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: open_form
tools.label: Open a form
tools.description: Bring a form or section on screen: navigates if needed and, for pop-up forms, taps its opener (e.g. "Connect Database"). Returns its fields, current values and which required fields are still missing.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: read_screen
tools.label: Read the screen
tools.description: Read what is on screen now: surfaces with their non-secret field values, errors, list rows (with their ids) and available actions.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: fill_fields
tools.label: Fill form fields
tools.description: Type values into fields of an on-screen surface (Orbit types them visibly). values is an object of field name to value. Never for secret or file fields. Returns per-field acceptance or validation errors and fields still missing.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: choose_option
tools.label: Choose a dropdown option
tools.description: Pick an option in a select field using the real loaded options, by option id or visible label. Returns the chosen option, or the candidates if ambiguous.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: press
tools.label: Press a button
tools.description: Press a button on an on-screen surface; the page does exactly what a user click does and the real result is returned. Row actions need row (the item id). Actions marked consequential need the user to confirm first.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: ask_secret_in_form
tools.label: Ask for a secret in the form
tools.description: Point at a password or API-key box in the form and let the user type it there themselves. Then WAIT_FOR_USER; you will be told when they have entered it. You never see the value.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: give_tour
tools.label: Give a tour of the portal
tools.description: Guided tour of the whole portal in one call: the browser visits every page in order, points at its main parts and explains each one in step with Orbit's voice (the explanations come from the knowledge stored by admins). Takes a few minutes; the user can stop it at any time. Returns the pages shown.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: explain_page
tools.label: Explain a page
tools.description: Explain one page in one call. depth "overview": a short explanation while pointing at its main area. depth "detailed": goes through every part: points at each field and button, opens and closes forms and popups (never changes data) and explains each one. page defaults to the page the user is on. Returns what was shown.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: show_me
tools.label: Show the user something
tools.description: Point at and highlight a field, button or the surface itself with a short caption, to guide the user.
tools.outcome: Visible action in the portal, acknowledged by the browser.
tools.side_effects: Operates the portal UI on screen.

tools.name: list_database_connections
tools.label: List Database Connections
tools.description: List all connected databases for the authenticated user.
tools.outcome: Retrieves database profiles, server versions, latency, and status.

tools.name: test_database_connection
tools.label: Test Database Connection
tools.description: Check whether a database is reachable. Pass connection_id to check the live status of a SAVED connection (updates its stored status). Or pass host, port, database and username to test NEW details before saving; the password is supplied securely by the app, never by you.
tools.outcome: Verifies network reachability, SSRF policy, and MySQL handshake.
tools.side_effects: Network handshake only; zero data mutation.

connection_id.description: Optional ID of existing connection to retest.

tools.name: save_database_connection
tools.label: Save Database Connection
tools.description: Save a new MySQL connection profile for the user. Re-tests connectivity first and refuses to save if the test fails. Requires name, host, database, username (port defaults to 3306). The password is supplied securely by the app.
tools.outcome: Persists database connection record with AES-256 encrypted password.

tools.name: update_database_connection
tools.label: Update Database Connection
tools.description: Update connection metadata or credentials for an existing database profile.
tools.outcome: Modifies platform database connection settings.

access_mode.description: Target database access mode: read_only, read_write, or read_write_delete.

tools.name: disconnect_database_connection
tools.label: Disconnect Database Profile
tools.description: Remove a saved platform database connection profile. Target customer database is completely untouched.
tools.outcome: Removes platform connection record.
tools.side_effects: Deletes DbConnection record in platform database.

force.description: Force deletion even if automations depend on it.

tools.name: scan_database_schema
tools.label: Scan Database Schema
tools.description: Introspect database schema and discover eligible tables for content automation.
tools.outcome: Scans tables, columns, data types, and primary/foreign keys.

tools.name: get_schema_scan_status
tools.label: Get Schema Details
tools.description: Retrieve table eligibility classifications and foreign key relationships.
tools.outcome: Returns latest cached schema snapshot.

tools.name: lookup_table_values
tools.label: Lookup Table Values
tools.description: Query allowable sample values or lookup references in an eligible target table (e.g. categories, tags, authors).
tools.outcome: Returns read-only sample rows for reference resolution.

tools.name: list_automations
tools.label: List Automations
tools.description: List all configured content generation and publishing workflows for the user.
tools.outcome: Returns list of automations with schedules, status, and target tables.

tools.name: get_automation_details
tools.label: Get Automation Details
tools.description: Retrieve complete configuration, prompts, schedule, and field mappings of an automation.
tools.outcome: Returns full automation specification.

tools.name: create_automation_draft
tools.label: Create Automation Draft
tools.description: Create a scheduled automation that writes new rows into a table (blog posts, articles, news, products, FAQs...). Columns you do not specify get the same safe defaults as the builder (AI text, AI-chosen category created if new, generated images, slug from title, publication-time dates). Publication must be at least 15 minutes after generation. Prefer doing it on screen in the builder when the browser is present.
tools.outcome: Persists Automation record with field mappings, topic prompt, and schedule.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; the run date for ONE_TIME.

topic_prompt.description: What the content should be about.

category_name.description: Optional category the AI should use (matched or created at run time).

field_mappings.description: Optional per-column overrides; omit to use the safe defaults.

timeout_policy.description: What happens if nobody approves before publication time.

tools.name: update_automation
tools.label: Update Automation Configuration
tools.description: Update schedule, prompt context, active status, or settings of an existing automation.
tools.outcome: Modifies platform Automation record.

tools.name: remove_automation
tools.label: Remove Automation
tools.description: Delete an automation configuration record from the platform database.
tools.outcome: Removes platform Automation record.

tools.name: run_automation_now
tools.label: Trigger Immediate Execution
tools.description: Immediately trigger a scheduled automation execution through the background queue.
tools.outcome: Creates a run that generates now in the background and publishes after the automation's usual gap (approval rules apply).
tools.side_effects: Creates AutomationExecution, enqueues background worker job.

tools.name: preview_automation_content
tools.label: Preview AI Content Draft
tools.description: Run a saved automation once as a dry run: real AI content, the parent records it would use or create, and the exact database write plan. Writes nothing.
tools.outcome: Returns generated preview JSON object.

tools.name: list_executions
tools.label: List Executions
tools.description: List recent automation executions with status, date, and target table.
tools.outcome: Returns execution run history.

tools.name: get_execution_status
tools.label: Get Execution Status
tools.description: Check detailed status, timeline events, and output of an automation run.
tools.outcome: Returns execution progress, target record ID, and error messages.

tools.name: retry_execution
tools.label: Retry Failed Execution
tools.description: Re-dispatch a failed execution job to background workers.
tools.outcome: Resets execution state to PENDING_GENERATION and re-enqueues job.

tools.name: request_execution_interrupt
tools.label: Request Execution Interrupt
tools.description: Request immediate pause or cancellation of a queued or running execution.
tools.outcome: Updates execution status to CANCELLED or PAUSED at safe boundary.

tools.name: explain_execution_failure
tools.label: Explain Execution Failure
tools.description: Analyze the latest failed execution and explain the root cause and safe fix.
tools.outcome: Returns actionable diagnosis and recovery instructions.

tools.name: update_published_record
tools.label: Update Published Customer Record
tools.description: Perform an audited, scoped UPDATE to a single target customer record (WHERE id = :id).
tools.outcome: Executes safe parameterized UPDATE on target customer database record.
tools.side_effects: Modifies allowable columns on specific single target record.

fields.description: Key-value map of allowable columns to update.

tools.name: get_pending_approvals
tools.label: Get Pending Approvals
tools.description: List content drafts waiting for user approval before publishing.
tools.outcome: Returns drafts in PENDING_APPROVAL status with payload previews.

tools.name: approve_content_version
tools.label: Approve Content Draft
tools.description: Approve a pending content version draft to proceed to scheduled or immediate publication.
tools.outcome: Approves the draft; it publishes at its scheduled time (immediately if that time has passed).

tools.name: reject_content_version
tools.label: Reject Content Draft
tools.description: Reject a pending content draft and trigger regeneration with corrective feedback.
tools.outcome: Rejects the draft with feedback and writes a new version (stops after three rejections).
tools.side_effects: Updates version to rejected, dispatches regeneration job.

feedback.description: Specific feedback explaining why to revise.

tools.name: list_ai_providers
tools.label: List AI Providers
tools.description: List configured AI providers with masked API keys and model preferences.
tools.outcome: Returns configured providers.

tools.name: test_ai_provider
tools.label: Test AI Provider Credentials
tools.description: Test connectivity and model availability for a specific AI provider.
tools.outcome: Verifies API key and returns model availability.

tools.name: save_ai_provider
tools.label: Save AI Provider Configuration
tools.description: Save or update user-specific AI provider credentials (encrypted at rest).
tools.outcome: Persists AiProvider configuration.

tools.name: get_provider_health
tools.label: Get Provider Health
tools.description: Check connectivity to local Ollama or active AI providers.
tools.outcome: Returns provider status, active model, and latency.

tools.name: list_knowledge_documents
tools.label: List Knowledge Documents
tools.description: List indexed knowledge documents (.pdf, .txt, .md) for the tenant workspace.
tools.outcome: Returns document list with chunk counts and index status.

tools.name: query_knowledge_base
tools.label: Search Knowledge Base
tools.description: Perform semantic search across workspace knowledge documents using vector embeddings.
tools.outcome: Returns relevant passages and relevance scores.

tools.name: search_orbit_knowledge
tools.label: Search Orbit's knowledge
tools.description: Search Orbit's knowledge of the website (pages, features, how requests are carried out) and the user's own documents with a query you write, best in clear English. Use it when the retrieved knowledge for the message does not cover a question or a step.
tools.outcome: The passages that match the query, with their source.

tools.name: remove_knowledge_document
tools.label: Remove Knowledge Document
tools.description: Remove a knowledge document and purge its vector embeddings from the index.
tools.outcome: Deletes KnowledgeDocument and purges embeddings.

tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.label: Get Workspace Dashboard Summary
tools.description: Get overview statistics of connections, automations, executions, and worker health.
tools.outcome: Returns workspace metrics counts and operational summary.

tools.name: list_audit_logs
tools.label: Search the audit log
tools.description: Search the user's audit trail (what was created, changed, deleted, approved, published, logged in...). Filter by free text, action, resource type and date range. Returns real counts, the first and last matching time, counts per action and the latest matching entries. Use it to answer questions like "did I ever add a connection?" or "what did I change yesterday?". If nothing matches it lists the action names that exist.
tools.outcome: Returns matching audit entries with totals.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "connection", "deleted", a table or automation name.

action.description: Part of an action name, e.g. CONNECTION_CREATED, DELETED, APPROVED.

tools.name: get_audit_log_entry
tools.label: Inspect an audit entry
tools.description: Read one audit entry in full (its details/metadata), by its id from list_audit_logs.
tools.outcome: Returns the full audit entry.

tools.name: ask_database
tools.label: Ask Database Question
tools.description: Answer any read-only question about the data in a connected database: counts, totals, rankings ("which customer has the most orders/refunds"), lists, lookups by email or id, date ranges. Pass the question in English with the details the user gave. The server writes one SELECT, checks it against the live schema and runs it read-only; results show emails/phones masked.
tools.outcome: Executes one validated read-only query and returns masked rows, the SQL used and its assumptions.

tools.name: find_dummy_data
tools.label: Find Dummy / Test Data
tools.description: Analyze database tables for seeded dummy or placeholder accounts, test emails, filler text, or burst timestamps. Pass table="recommended" (or omit) to scan recommended content tables, table="all" to scan all tables, or a specific table name like "users".
tools.outcome: Returns dummy data report with evidence, confidence, and sample masked records.

table.description: Specific table name (e.g. "users"), "recommended" for content/entity tables (default), or "all" to scan all tables.

tools.name: preview_data_change
tools.label: Preview Database Change
tools.description: Prepare a change to rows of a table, nothing is written yet: action insert (rows: list of objects keyed by column name), update (filter + patch_values) or delete (filter or ids, guarded). Returns the preview, then the user confirms; deletes need the typed phrase. Pass connection_id when several databases are connected.
tools.outcome: Creates a pending DataChangeRequest with pinned primary keys and masked preview rows.

tools.name: confirm_data_change
tools.label: Confirm and Execute Data Change
tools.description: Atomically execute a previewed UPDATE (pinned to previewed PKs) or guarded DELETE (requiring typed confirmation phrase).
tools.outcome: Executes the pinned change in a transaction with TOCTOU row count verification and encrypted before-image.

tools.name: undo_data_change
tools.label: Undo Executed Data Change
tools.description: Revert an executed UPDATE or DELETE using the stored encrypted before-image.
tools.outcome: Restores the original row values in a transaction.

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.label: Get Account Profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's account profile details: name, email, timezone, workspace stats, AI token usage, and session count.
tools.outcome: Retrieves user profile details and workspace metrics.

tools.name: update_account_profile
tools.label: Update Account Profile
tools.description: Update the authenticated user's profile information: name, email, or timezone.
tools.outcome: Updates user profile details.
